consequence.statement: If the operator does nothing, upgrading to Strimzi 0.46.0 or newer is not supported: the mandatory pre-upgrade step is to make sure all Kafka clusters are using KRaft, because ZooKeeper-based clusters and the ZooKeeper-to-KRaft migration are no longer supported in 0.46.0.
consequence.remediation: Before upgrading to Strimzi 0.46.0 or newer, migrate all Kafka clusters from ZooKeeper-based operation to KRaft.

assertion.statement: Strimzi 0.46.0 removes support for ZooKeeper-based Kafka clusters and for migrating ZooKeeper-based clusters to KRaft; the changelog instructs operators to make sure all their clusters are using KRaft before upgrading to 0.46.0 or newer.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: No evidence or artifact context identifies a static input (values key, resource field, or flag) that distinguishes a ZooKeeper-based Kafka cluster from a KRaft one, so the exposed environment state cannot be expressed as a safe predicate.
